records.description: Santa Justa is Seville's main railway station, a modern passenger terminal east of the historic centre. Old cruising-directory entries describe public toilets inside the station, and two independent sites have carried references to the same building. Neither has supplied a readable, dated 2026 encounter or a precise contemporary meeting section. One directory offers historic suggestions about individual cubicles and afternoon visits, but there is no evidence the layout or access arrangements remain the same. Adif manages station facilities and visitor information, and passengers, staff and security use the terminal throughout the day. Current station opening hours do not confirm that a particular toilet is open or used for cruising. Without a verified restroom entrance, current visiting pattern or firsthand account, it should not be presented as an active cruising destination.
blockers: Specific toilet and current layout not verified
records.address: Estación Sevilla-Santa Justa, Avenida Kansas City, Seville
records.tags: Railway Station, Public Restroom, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: Station and WC times controlled by Adif; historic afternoon claim is not current evidence.

records.description: Parque de María Luisa is Seville's large ornamental garden south of the historic centre, full of shaded paths, small squares and planted corners. Gay cruising directories have named the park for years, with some older accounts pointing towards quieter southern paths. An August 2026 conversation on Cruisingmap contains invitations or proposed meetings, while another recent online guide repeats the park's reputation; neither establishes a completed firsthand encounter in the same period. The municipality's winter park hours are roughly 08:00–22:00. Old accounts mentioning entry through damaged fencing are not legitimate access directions and should be ignored. This is a popular public attraction for locals and visitors, and its large size makes a precise meeting point essential. Reliable current crowd information and a documented best visiting time are still missing.
blockers: 2026 posts are proposed meetings, not confirmed visits
Large park lacks precise current subarea
Nighttime access limited by municipal gates
records.tags: Public Garden, Southern Paths, Historical Cruising
records.opening_notes: Municipal winter park opening around 08:00–22:00; follow posted gate restrictions.

records.description: Parking Severo Ochoa is an operating covered car park in Granada, with controlled entrances, staff and video surveillance. A cruising directory lists its name, but doesn't identify a particular floor, restroom, access point or recent visit. The operator's 2026 information confirms that the business itself is open around the clock; that fact should not be confused with evidence that any part of the building is a cruising destination. Ordinary customers use the car park, and its controlled spaces are subject to operator rules and monitoring. There is no reliable information on a visiting period, age mix, cruising activity or whether the original lead was ever accurate. This should not be promoted merely because the building can be located on a map and is open 24 hours.
blockers: Controlled and surveilled facility, not a verified meeting area
records.opening_notes: Operator lists car park as 24 hours; not evidence of any cruising hours.

records.description: The Jardin des Tuileries stretches between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde, with formal paths, wooded sections and busy tourist areas. Its reputation as a gay cruising spot appears in older guide listings and a July 2024 Le Parisien report, but there isn't a clear, dated 2026 firsthand account tied to a specific corner of the gardens. A January discussion mentioning a maze near the Louvre does not reliably identify this location, and other contributors questioned whether the former scene still existed. The Louvre publishes seasonal garden opening times: in November the grounds open around 07:30 and close around 19:30, with clearing starting before then. Any old recommendation to go late at night is therefore misleading. There are too many uncertainties about current activity, specific paths and access to publish this as a dependable spot.

records.description: The Bois de Vincennes is a huge woodland park on Paris's eastern edge, so a directory entry simply called 'Bois de Vincennes 1' doesn't establish one meaningful cruising location. Older reporting identified gay meetings around parts of the woods near the seasonal naturist area, and an October 2026 online commenter described seeing men having sex in woodland during the summer. That is a recent firsthand claim about part of the larger forest, not proof that this specific numbered directory entry identifies the same spot. The City of Paris permits naturism in a designated area only during a defined season; the 2026 season ended on 25 October, and public exhibitionism is prohibited. The woods contain many other recreation and wildlife areas. Before listing, this needs a distinct, correctly pinned section and current access guidance rather than a broad map point.
blockers: Numbered directory entry lacks specific distinguishable location
2026 observation cannot be assigned to that exact candidate
Seasonal naturist-zone rules and public access must be distinguished
